newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU STRIKES DEAL WITH BELGACOM ON PHONE DIRECTORIES.
newsitem.headline: EU STRIKES DEAL WITH BELGACOM ON PHONE DIRECTORIES.

text.p: The European Commission said on Friday it had struck a deal with Belgian telephone company Belgacom in a dispute over prices that it charges telephone directory publishers for information about its subscribers.
The Commission, which investigated after receiving a complaint from ITT Promedia, said Belgacom had agreed to align its charges closer to its actual costs.
"This approach will lead to a substantial cut -- more than 90 percent -- in the amount initially charged telephone directory publishers," it said in a statement.
Belgacom had been basing its prices for subscriber data on a percentage of a publisher's turnover, then adding an additional charge per line of data.

"Following this agreement, the price will be fixed so that Belgacom can obtain coverage of the costs of collecting, treating and supplying data for the edition, plus a reasonable margin of profit," the Commission said in a statement.
ITT Promedia, a unit of ITT World Directories , publishes both white and yellow pages in competition with Belgacom Directory Services. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
